title: Vampire Vape Desserts Pistachio Milkshake 10ml  E-Liquid
description: Pistachio Milkshake by Vampire Vape Desserts offers a luxurious blend of roasted Pistachio flavour stirred through a smooth, velvety Milkshake base. This indulgent vape captures the nutty richness of Pistachio, mellowed by the cool creaminess of a classic milkshake drink, for an expertly layered and comforting flavour experience. Available in 0mg, 3mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg freebase nicotine strengths, this e-liquid is tailored for mouth-to-lung (MTL) vaping with pod kits, starter devices, and vape pens. The 3mg strength features a balanced 50VG/50PG blend, while the 0mg, 6mg, 12mg, and 18mg strengths are blended at 40VG/60PG to offer a slightly stronger throat hit and enhanced flavour delivery. Produced in the UK and fully TPD-compliant, Pistachio Milkshake is part of the Vampire Vape Desserts collection — a decadent range of e-liquids crafted to bring familiar sweet flavours into your everyday vape. Also available in High-VG Shortfills and DIY Concentrates.
